name: Off Air: Five Nights
storyline:
After a late-night stream, Klandar receives a mysterious package from an unknown sender. When he runs the program inside, it transports him into the world of Five Nights at Freddy’s, a place he’s only ever seen on a screen. Now he’s inside the pizzeria, where security cameras pick up movement in seemingly empty hallways, and dawn is still hours away.

At his side is Mike, the night guard, who knows more about the place than he’s willing to share. To survive the night, you’ll have to face your fears, make difficult choices, and look for answers. Will you trust your partner or follow your suspicions? Stick to the rules or risk everything to uncover the truth?

Off Air: Five Nights is a story about trust, memory, and the line between games and reality. Your choices shape Klandar’s relationship with Mike and determine which ending you reach.
summary: After a late-night stream, Klandar receives a strange package from an unknown sender. When he runs the program inside, he’s transported into the world of Five Nights at Freddy’s. In this horror visual novel, players guide Klandar through five nights in a pizzeria. Their choices shape his relationship with Mike, the night guard, and determine how the story ends.
